name: Mirror with Handle, Decorated with "Double Happiness" and Five Bats
dimensions: Diameter: 16.5 cm (6 1/2 in.); Overall: 0.6 cm (1/4 in.); Rim: 0.6 cm (1/4 in.)
summary: This mirror bears a large character of xi 囍 ("double happiness," as in a marriage) as its principal decoration.
